data.title: 泽塔 · 月夜森林的侦察
data.description: 月夜的密林里，泽塔蹲在树枝上俯瞰林间空地。篝火已经熄灭，散落的物件和脚印仍留在地上；她默记下离开的方向，准备继续追踪。
data.location: dense moonlit forest with a deserted clearing, an extinguished campfire and scattered supplies
data.action: crouching alone on a tree branch, watching an empty clearing and its extinguished campfire
data.lighting: 密林枝叶间漏下的冷白月光
data.mood: noiseless infiltration, hunter in the canopy
data.promptProse: From a high branch, Zeta silently studies the deserted clearing below, where an extinguished campfire and scattered supplies remain in the moonlight.
data.animaCaption: Zeta watches the abandoned camp from the shelter of the leaves.
